body:
Halcyon Days!
On obtaining a forged prescription for Halcion was straight down to the chemist! Am widely experienced with cannabis, LSD, Mushies, some research chems etc and many pharms. Halcion gives me the perfect Benzo buzz.....gently fuzzing me away into a not so deep but comfortable and dreamless sleep. Wake up feeling perfect with no hangover or drowsiness next day.
Am currently on Zimovane now (3 yrs later) and they stink! Get hangover next day,,, mouth tastes like tin foil and have a headache!
Bring back Halcion!
